name: Accordion
description:
Accessible accordion following the ARIA APG accordion pattern: each header is a
button (`aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`) inside an `<h3>`, each panel is a
`role="region"` labelled by its header. Arrow-key navigation moves focus
between headers (`Home`/`End` jump to the first/last enabled one); `Enter`/
`Space` toggle natively since headers are real `<button>` elements. Data-driven
(`items`), consistent with {@link DropdownMenu} and {@link Tabs}. Always fills
its container's width (doesn't shrink-wrap to the currently expanded content),
so its width stays stable as items open and close.

props.name: items
props.description: Accordion items, in order

props.name: type
props.description: `'single'` allows only one item open at a time; `'multiple'` allows any number. Default `'single'`

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled set of expanded item values. Omit to let Accordion manage its own state

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial expanded values when uncontrolled. Default `[]` (all collapsed)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called whenever the expanded set changes

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When `type` is `'single'`, allows clicking the open item to collapse it, leaving none open. Default `true`

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which side of the trigger label the expand/collapse chevron renders on. Default `'right'`

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class applied to the root element

name: Alert
description:
Inline, persistent banner for page-level messages (as opposed to {@link Toast},
which is for transient notifications that appear and disappear on their own).
Persistent by default; pass `autoDismiss` to opt into auto-hiding it instead.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual and semantic tone of the alert

props.name: title
props.description: Bold heading above the description

props.name: children
props.description: Description content

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button

props.name: autoDismiss
props.description:
Auto-dismisses the alert after `autoDismissDelay`. Off by default — Alert is
meant to be a *persistent* banner (unlike Toast, which already auto-dismisses).

⚠️ Avoid for messages the user must read or act on: an alert that disappears
on its own without user input can conflict with WCAG 2.2.1 (Timing Adjustable).
Prefer `dismissible` (manual close) for anything important.

props.name: autoDismissDelay
props.description: Delay in ms before auto-dismissing. Only applies when `autoDismiss` is true. Default `8000`

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the alert is dismissed, manually or automatically. Required when `dismissible` or `autoDismiss` is true

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

name: DropdownMenu
description:
Accessible dropdown menu positioned with Floating UI (flips/shifts to stay in
the viewport). Supports arrow-key navigation, typeahead (type a letter to jump
to a matching item), `Escape` to close with focus returned to the trigger, and
disabled items/separators. Supports controlled (`open`/`onOpenChange`) and
uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) modes, same as {@link Popover}. The trigger is
wrapped in a `<span>` rather than cloned onto `children`, so it works with
any trigger — including this library's own components, none of which use
`forwardRef`.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger element that opens the menu on click

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries, in order

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred corner; flips automatically when there isn't room in the viewport

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit to let the menu manage its own state

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the open state changes (click on trigger, select an item, outside click, Escape)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the menu entirely; children render without any wrapper or listeners

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class applied to the menu panel

name: Modal
description:
Accessible modal dialog: traps focus inside the panel while open (`FloatingFocusManager`,
modal), locks background scroll, and returns focus to the previously focused element
on close. Unlike {@link Popover} and {@link DropdownMenu}, it has no trigger — rendering
is fully controlled via the `open`/`onClose` props.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is open. Modal has no trigger of its own — rendering is fully controlled

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called to request closing (Escape, backdrop click, or the built-in close button)

props.name: title
props.description: Visible heading rendered at the top of the panel; also wired up as the dialog's accessible name

props.name: children
props.description: Panel content

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name fallback when there's no visible `title` (required in that case for valid ARIA)

props.name: closeOnBackdropClick
props.description: Closes the modal when the backdrop is clicked. Default `true`

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Closes the modal on `Escape`. Default `true`

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class applied to the panel

name: Popover
description:
Accessible popover for interactive content, positioned with Floating UI
(flips/shifts to stay in the viewport).

Unlike {@link Tooltip}, it opens on click (not hover), traps focus inside the
panel while open (`FloatingFocusManager`, non-modal), and returns focus to the
trigger on close. The trigger is wrapped in a `<span>` rather than cloned onto
`children`, so it works with any trigger — including this library's own
components, none of which use `forwardRef`. Because of that wrapper, `aria-expanded`
can't be exposed on the actual interactive trigger element, so pass `aria-label`
to describe the panel instead (required for `role="dialog"` to be valid ARIA).

props.name: content
props.description: Interactive content rendered inside the popover panel

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger element that toggles the popover on click

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips automatically when there isn't room in the viewport

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit to let the popover manage its own state

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the open state changes (click on trigger, outside click, Escape)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the popover entirely; children render without any wrapper or listeners

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class applied to the popover panel

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible name for the panel (`role="dialog"` requires one). Required unless
`content` already renders a visible, labelled heading referenced via
`aria-labelledby` on a wrapper you control.

name: Tabs
description:
Accessible tabs following the ARIA APG tabs pattern: roving tabindex, arrow-key
navigation (`Home`/`End` jump to the first/last enabled tab), and automatic
activation — moving focus with the keyboard selects the tab immediately,
matching how native OS tabs behave. Disabled tabs are skipped during
navigation. Data-driven (`items`), not a compound component — consistent with
{@link DropdownMenu}, the only other data-driven list component in this
library.

props.name: items
props.description: Tabs, in order

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value. Omit to let Tabs manage its own state

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected value when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first enabled tab

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called whenever the selected tab changes (click or arrow-key navigation)

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout and arrow-key direction. Default `'horizontal'`

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class applied to the root element

name: Toast

`useToast().toast(...)` from inside a {@link ToastProvider}, which manages

name: Tooltip
description:
Accessible tooltip positioned with Floating UI (flips/shifts to stay in the viewport).

The trigger is wrapped in a `<span>` rather than cloned onto `children`, so it works
with any trigger — including this library's own components, none of which use
`forwardRef`. The tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus, and closes on
`Escape` or on blur/mouse leave.

props.name: content
props.description: Content rendered inside the tooltip bubble when open

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger element(s) the tooltip is attached to

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips automatically when there isn't room in the viewport

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay (ms) before showing/hiding on hover. A number applies to both; pass an object to set them independently

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the tooltip entirely; children render without any wrapper or listeners

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class applied to the tooltip bubble
